what_it_does: This paper presents AMD's 4th Generation CDNA GPU architecture, designed specifically to accelerate AI and large language model inference workloads. The key challenge is that modern AI models demand enormous amounts of memory bandwidth (the speed at which data flows into the computing units) and specialized arithmetic operations on partially-precise numbers (mixed-precision compute, which trades some numerical accuracy for speed). The solution adds more computing cores per unit area, improves how data moves through the memory hierarchy (the pyramid of fast, expensive caches and slower, larger storage), enhances the tensor cores (specialized circuits for matrix multiplication), and includes new instructions (processor commands) tuned for transformer networks—the neural network architecture behind most modern language models. The new version aims to process inference requests faster and more energy-efficiently than the previous generation.
